t: The Kinara has a directional facing and can be placed upon an Mkeka if desired.$(br2)It is fully functional and is designed to emulate the lighting of the Kwanzaa candles in order.
金纳拉具有方向朝向，如需还可置于麦凯卡之上。$(br2)它功能完备，专为按顺序模拟宽扎节蜡烛点燃过程而设计。

To light the Kinara, you will need the following: $(li)1 Black Candle $(li) 3 Red Candles $(li) 3 Green Candles $(li)Flint and Steel $(br2)The candles go into the Kinara in the following color order: Black, Red, Green, Red, Green, Red, Green.
点燃金纳拉需准备以下物品：$(li)1支黑色蜡烛 $(li)3支红色蜡烛 $(li)3支绿色蜡烛 $(li)打火石 $(br2)蜡烛按如下颜色顺序置入金纳拉：黑、红、绿、红、绿、红、绿。

Begin by placing the first candle, and then light it. Then place the second, and light it. Repeat this process until all candles are lit.$(br2)A chat message will appear denoting each candle as it is lit.The more candles that are lit, the more light the Kinara will give off.
首先放置第一支蜡烛并点燃；随后放置第二支并点燃；依此类推，直至全部蜡烛点亮。$(br2)每次点燃一支蜡烛，聊天栏均会显示提示消息。点亮的蜡烛越多，金纳拉散发的光亮越强。

If you use the wrong color candle, it will give the most recently placed candle back to you and you can try again.$(br2)If your Kinara does not light up, remove all of the candles (just click with an empty hand) and place them/light them again in the proper order.
若误用错误颜色的蜡烛，系统将返还你最新放置的那支蜡烛，供你重试。$(br2)若金纳拉未能点亮，请先全部移除蜡烛（空手点击即可），再按正确顺序重新放置并点燃。
